{{Quote|Fighter pilots. The Old Republic had its Jedi; Adumar has its fighter pilots. They love them, a case of hero worship that spans their whole culture. Their entertainments revolve around them. Social promotion, properties, titles, all accompany military promotion in their pilot corps.|Airen Cracken on the Adumari|<ref name="SOF">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>}}
The '''Adumari''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]], which they colonized approximately ten thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] ago after staging a rebellion against the [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]]. They were defeated and spared so long as they went far away and ceased making trouble.<ref name="SOF" />

Adumari history indicated a pattern of repeated internal conflict, with the populace waging wars among themselves to the point of driving their own civilization into poverty and barbarism on at least two occasions. Despite these cycles of self-destruction, fragments of their ancient instructional recordings endured for thousands of years, preserving elements of their cultural memory. Their language managed to retain continuity, remaining a recognizable dialect of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] even after millennia.<ref name="SOF" />

They were completely forgotten by the Old Republic and went ignored during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] era. It was only after being stumbled into by a deep-space scout of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during a mapping mission into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] that they were discovered.<ref name="SOF" />

Their culture was steep in military worship of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], going as far as having their entertainments revolve around them. Advancement within the Adumari pilot corps carried significant civilian benefits, including elevated social standing, property rights, and formal titles. Duels were a norm for them, whether its [[starfighter combat]] or through [[blastsword]]s, all in order to achieve honor.<ref name="SOF" />

In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], the New Republic sent a diplomatic [[Mission to Adumar|mission]] to the planet in order to convince them to join the Republic. Owing the Adumari's obsession with pilots, the New Republic chose to send their best&mdash;[[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and his fellow [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] pilots [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]], and [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]].<ref name="SOF" />
